# SlickText
> SlickText is the #1 rated SMS marketing platform. We help businesses connect with their customers through text messaging, offering tools for mass texting, automated workflows, segmentation, analytics, and integrations with platforms like Shopify, HubSpot, and Zapier. Over 15,000 brands rely on SlickText. Founded with a decade of SMS marketing expertise.
For detailed documentation, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.slicktext.com/llms-full.txt).
## Company Info
- Website: https://www.slicktext.com
- Support: https://help.slicktext.com
- API Docs: https://api.slicktext.com
- Blog: https://www.slicktext.com/blog/
- Phone: 1-800-688-6290

## Features
- [All Features](https://www.slicktext.com/features/): Full list of SMS marketing features
- [Campaigns](https://www.slicktext.com/features/campaigns): Targeted, personalized mass texting campaigns
- [Inbox](https://www.slicktext.com/features/inbox): Two-way conversational messaging
- [Workflows](https://www.slicktext.com/features/workflows): Automated texting workflows and drip campaigns
- [Segments](https://www.slicktext.com/features/segments): Audience segmentation for targeted messaging
- [Analytics](https://www.slicktext.com/features/analytics): Campaign performance tracking and reporting
- [Website Popups](https://www.slicktext.com/features/website-popups): Subscriber opt-in popups for websites
- [Text to Join](https://www.slicktext.com/features/text-to-join): Keyword-based subscriber opt-in
- [SMS Autoresponders](https://www.slicktext.com/features/sms-autoresponders): Automatic text message replies
- [Web Forms](https://www.slicktext.com/features/web-forms): Embeddable subscriber sign-up forms
- [Text to Win Contests](https://www.slicktext.com/features/text-to-win-contests): SMS-based promotional contests
## Services
- [Mass Text Messaging](https://www.slicktext.com/mass-text-messaging-service): Send texts to large audiences
- [Text Message Automation](https://www.slicktext.com/text-message-automation): Automated SMS workflows

- [Text Blasts](https://www.slicktext.com/text-blast-service): Bulk text message broadcasting
- [Text Broadcasts](https://www.slicktext.com/text-broadcast-service): Text broadcast messaging
- [Text Promotions](https://www.slicktext.com/text-promotions): Promotional text messaging
- [SMS Short Codes](https://www.slicktext.com/sms-short-code-service): Dedicated short code texting
- [Text to Landline](https://www.slicktext.com/text-to-landline): Enable texting on landline numbers
- [Enterprise SMS](https://www.slicktext.com/enterprise): Enterprise-grade SMS marketing software
- [HIPAA Compliant Texting](https://www.slicktext.com/hipaa-compliant-texting): Healthcare-compliant messaging

 AUDIENCE GROWTH
 
 
Growth Tools

Web Forms

web forms
. Start from our library of templates or build your web form from scratch.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Website Popups
 
 
 
Capture attention with 
website popups
 and influence buyer behavior from their first browsing session.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tap-to-Join Links
 
 
 
Provide followers with a frictionless, two-tap opt-in experience. Tap-to-join links are a convenient and effective way to grow your text marketing lists on social media, marketing emails, web, and other clickable assets.
 
 
 
 
 
 
QR Codes
 
 
 
Generate custom QR codes to capture subscribers or direct customers to key destinations like menus, booking links, and product pages.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Keywords
 
 
 
Allow customers to subscribe to your 
SMS marketing
 by texting a designated word or phrase to your number. Send customized auto-responses or trigger automations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 MASS MESSAGING
 
 
Campaigns
 
Send personalized messages at scale with Campaigns.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Mass Texting
 
 
 
Send 
mass text messages
 to audiences of ten, ten million, and beyond. Reach your entire list or target segments based on contact data and behavior.
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI Compose
 
 
 
Leverage AI to craft the perfect message in your mass texting campaigns. Optimize tone, length, and emoji usage. Choose your favorite draft and edit or instantly send.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Personalization
 
 
 
Address contacts by name and deliver personalized content to increase customer engagement and response.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Contact Cards
 
 
 
Create, customize, and send contact cards within SlickText. Attach your contact card to your opt-in auto-response to increase deliverability and engagement.
 
 
 
 
 
 
MMS
 
 
 
Easily attach images, gifs, and videos to any text message and drive more responses.
 
Send up to 1,600 characters in a single 
MMS marketing
 message. That's 10X longer than the standard SMS.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Message Scheduling
 
 
 
Schedule campaigns in advance to maintain consistent engagement without manual work.
 
 
 
 
Learn more about Campaigns 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ONE-ON-ONE MESSAGING
 
 
Inbox
 
 Collaborate on customer care by engaging with contacts in private, two-way text messaging.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Private Conversations
 
 
 
Deliver an exceptional experience with one-on-one messaging with every subscriber.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tags and Statuses
 
 
 
Organize conversations by tags and status so incoming messages don’t fall through the cracks.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Real-Time Collaboration
 
 
 
Collaborate on customer messaging with your entire support team. Leave notes, rotate assignments, and clear your inbox together.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automated Rules
 
 
 
Assign conversations based on your team’s needs, close conversations after a set number of days, and configure auto-responses outside of office hours.
 
 
 
 
Learn more about Inbox 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 AUTOMATION
 
 
Workflows
 
Design the perfect customer journey with our drag-and-drop workflow builder. Choose from dozens of templates or start from a blank canvas.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Welcome Series & Drip Messaging
 
 
 
Incentivize first-time buyers with welcome offers. Send 
automated text messages
 tailored to each individual that deliver exactly when you want them to.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Web Session Tracking & Ecommerce Automations
 
 
 
Track browsing sessions and move customers through workflows based on page views, product views, cart statuses, and other 
Shopify SMS
 conditions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Review Collection
 
 
 
Automate review collection by incentivizing your biggest fans to post reviews on Yelp, Google, and other platforms your customers care about.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Conversational Data Collection
 
 
 
Collect valuable contact data for smarter segmentation with AI agents that match your brand voice, so it feels like your team is personally chatting with each subscriber.
 
 
 
 
 
 
A/B Tests
 
 
 
Set up automated tests to compare messaging, CTAs, send times, and other variables.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Birthday Texts
 
 
 
Send personalized birthday messages to every subscriber. Include a special offer or simply wish them a happy birthday.
 
 
 
 
Learn more about Workflows 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Analytics
 
Track performance across the areas that matter most, including click-through rates, subscriber growth, campaign engagement, workflow performance, revenue attribution, and response times. Real-time reporting helps you understand what's working, improve SMS marketing ROI, and create more effective customer experiences.
 
Book a demo 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Audience Management
 
 Leverage our powerful contact management tools to collect subscriber data, create hyper-targeted segments, and manage contact preferences.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation
 
 
 
Segment your audience
 based on limitless data points and real-time behavior so you can create tailored, personalized campaigns that appeal to every customer.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Custom Fields
 
 
 
In addition to standard fields like name, email, and date of birth, you can store an unlimited amount of custom contact data that is meaningful to your business. Then use that information to segment your audience and send personalized 
text promotions
.
 
 
 
 
 
 
List Uploads
 
 
 
Already have a texting list? Simply upload your subscribers directly into the platform. The express written consent your subscribers have previously provided to receive your text messages is transferable.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Self Cleaning Lists
 
 
 
Automatically track dead, disconnected, and unreachable numbers. If patterns of consecutive non-delivery are recognized, those numbers are removed, preventing you from wasting messages on contacts that aren't reachable.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SMS Compliance & Deliverability
 
 Protect your business, maximize message delivery, and stay compliant with evolving carrier and regulatory requirements.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
White Glove Number Registration
 
 
 
Simplify toll-free, 10DLC, short code, or RCS registration with expert support from our team. We handle the process from start to finish, minimize the work on your end, and help you launch your texting program quickly and smoothly.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Proven Opt-In Methods
 
 
 
Capture compliant opt-ins with list growth tools that make it almost impossible for your messages to get flagged as spam.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Age Verification
 
 
 
Help meet age-related compliance requirements by requiring subscribers to verify their date of birth before joining your messaging program.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Double Opt-In
 
 
 
Add a second confirmation step that requires subscribers to verify their enrollment, helping prevent accidental or unauthorized signups.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Consent Management
 
 
 
SlickText automatically captures and maintains records of subscriber consent according to the latest compliance requirements.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Opt-Out Intelligence
 
 
 
Automatically process standard opt-out keywords like STOP and UNSUBSCRIBE. An optional AI-powered feature can also recognize typos and conversational opt-out requests, then unsubscribe the contact or send opt-out instructions based on your settings.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Premium Carrier Relationships
 
 
 
Our well-established carrier relationships help fast track number registrations, support reliable message delivery, and keep us responsive to evolving industry requirements so you can send with confidence.
 
 
 
 
 
 
High-Volume Messaging Infrastructure
 
 
 
Power high-volume campaigns with infrastructure designed to send messages quickly, reliably, and at scale.

Common Pricing Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
Does SlickText offer RCS messaging?
 
 
Yes. SlickText offers RCS messaging, allowing businesses to send messages with a verified business profile that helps customers instantly recognize and trust their brand.
 
RCS is available for a $500 one-time setup fee and a $200 annual maintenance fee. Contact our team to get started.
 
 
 
 
What countries does SlickText work in?
 
 
SlickText currently supports SMS messaging in 
the United States and Canada.
 You can create, schedule, and send campaigns to phone numbers in both countries.
 
 
 
 
Which features are included in my paid plan?
 
 
We don’t gate-keep innovation. You’ll get full access to every feature, including integrations and Workflows, no matter your plan size.
 
 
 
 
Are there benefits to selecting an annual plan?
 
 
Yes! Annual plans unlock two free months of message credits and give you the flexibility to use your message credits over the course of a year. This is the preferred option for businesses that increase their message frequency a few times per year, instead of communicating evenly across each month.
 
 
 
 
What are rollover texts?
 
 
Rollover texts are unused credits on your monthly or annual plan. These can be used for one term following your billing date. Monthly plans include one month of rollover texts. Annual plans include one year of rollover texts.
 
 
 
 
Can I add my teammates to my account?
 
 
Yes! You can add additional team members to your SlickText account. We recommend inviting your team as soon as you create your account and learning the platform together.
 
 
 
 
What does the 1-on-1 onboarding session cover?
 
 
We're serious about your success with our 
mass texting service
. We'll connect you with an in-house expert who helps you set up your texting program around your business and use case. They'll walk you through compliance tools, help you grow your subscriber list, and map out a messaging plan built around your goals.
 
 
 
 
What if I go over my monthly message allowance?
 
 
As a SlickText user, you never have to be concerned about surprise charges. We’ll give you a heads up if you’re running low on credits so you can adjust your plan as needed.
 
 
 
 
Do you match prices from SimpleTexting?
 
 
Yes. We'll match any SimpleTexting standard plan price. For high-volume or custom needs, contact our team for a tailored quote.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What number types can I choose from?
 
 
SlickText offers four sending options: 10DLC (10-digit long code) numbers, toll-free numbers, short codes, and RCS (rich communications services).
 
 
A toll-free number is a 10-digit number that starts with a toll-free area code such as 833.
 
A 10DLC number is a 10-digit number with a local area code.
 
A 
short code
 is a 5 or 6-digit number designed for high-volume messaging.
 
RCS is a premium messaging experience that makes your business instantly recognizable on customers' phones.
 
 
Not sure which option is right for you? Our team can help you choose the best sending number based on your messaging goals, audience size, and use case.
 
 
 
 
How do you count message credits?
 
 
Each message credit is equal to one industry standard SMS message segment to one subscriber. An SMS message segment contains 160 characters. An MMS (message sent with an image or other supported file types) consumes 3 message credits per segment. However, an MMS message segment can contain up to 1,600 characters.
 
 
 
 
How does the free trial work?
 
 
During your free trial, you’ll get 14 days to experience every feature. There’s no credit card required and you can upgrade at any time.
 
 
 
 
How quickly can I get my phone number registered?
 
 
We work closely with the wireless carriers so you can experience fast-track verification. In many cases your sending number is registered within a few hours of your request.
 
 
 
 
Can I get help with my campaigns after I sign up?
 
 
Yes. Plans starting at $129 include a free 1-on-1 onboarding session with our client success team to help you get going with our 
SMS marketing software
. Beyond that, our support specialists are available by chat, phone, or email.
 
 
 
 
Can I get ongoing strategy advice for my brand?
 
 
Yes! Plan sizes of 50,000 credits and larger include access to a dedicated Customer Success Manager who will help monitor your performance, provide tailored SMS marketing advice, and offer live support as needed. 
 
 
 
 
What carrier fees are charged?
 
 
Most cellular carriers charge a small additional per-message fee to send texts on their networks. These fees vary based on the type of number you’re sending from, what country you’re sending in, and whether a message is an SMS or MMS message. We pass these fees through to you at no additional markup. You can learn more about carrier fees and 
how they work here
.
 
 
 
 
Do plan prices include sales tax?
 
 
Taxes will be included where appropriate.
